question: Integrate differentially expressed genes and proteins, and identify concordant vs. discordant regulation trends. Classify each gene as concordant if RNA and protein log2 fold-changes have the same sign (both positive or both negative), and discordant if they have opposite signs.

expected_output.guidelines: Numeric values must match within +/-1e-6; RNA_dir, Protein_dir, and Regulation are case-insensitive; column order and row order may differ.
